contents.description: A `Tensor` of type `string`. 0-D. The JPEG-encoded image.

channels.description: An optional `int`. Defaults to `0`. Number of color channels for the decoded image.

ratio.description: An optional `int`. Defaults to `1`. Downscaling ratio.

fancy_upscaling.description: An optional `bool`. Defaults to `True`. If true use a slower but nicer upscaling of the chroma planes (yuv420/422 only).

try_recover_truncated.description: An optional `bool`. Defaults to `False`. If true try to recover an image from truncated input.

acceptable_fraction.description: An optional `float`. Defaults to `1`. The minimum required fraction of lines before a truncated input is accepted.

dct_method.description: An optional `string`. Defaults to `""`. string specifying a hint about the algorithm used for decompression. Defaults to "" which maps to a system-specific default. Currently valid values are ["INTEGER_FAST", "INTEGER_ACCURATE"]. The hint may be ignored (e.g., the internal jpeg library changes to a version that does not have that specific option.)
constraints: dct_method must be one of string, INTEGER_FAST, INTEGER_ACCURATE
